mapper.sql: id,workflow_id AS workflowId,workflow_version_id AS workflowVersionId,space_id AS spaceId, owner_user_id AS ownerUserId,engine_profile AS engineProfile,state,assignment_json AS assignmentJson,model_permit_json AS modelPermitJson, input_hash AS inputHash,idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey,worker_id AS workerId,lease_id AS leaseId, attempt,lease_expires_at AS leaseExpiresAt,execution_started_at AS executionStartedAt,deadline,last_event_seq AS lastEventSeq,revision, result_json AS resultJson,result_hash AS resultHash,create_by AS createBy,create_time AS createTime,update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM paiflow_run WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM paiflow_run WHERE owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
SELECT FROM paiflow_run WHERE state='QUEUED' AND engine_profile=#{engineProfile} ORDER BY create_time,id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM paiflow_run WHERE engine_profile=#{engineProfile} AND ((state='QUEUED' AND deadline <= #{now}) OR (state IN('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND (deadline <= #{now} OR lease_expires_at <= #{now}))) ORDER BY create_time,id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT event_json FROM paiflow_run_event WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND seq=#{seq}
SELECT event_json FROM paiflow_run_event WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND seq > #{after} ORDER BY seq LIMIT #{limit}
